overview_description.description:
Jet Admin is a software company that manages and visualizes application data with dashboards, collections, and widgets. The company provides a ready-to-run admin panel designed to increase the operational efficiency of businesses of all sizes. It enables to connect and combine data from various data sources like Stripe, PostgreSQL, Google Sheets, and Firebase.

Jet Admin also builds internal tools to manage client documents, issue new cards, and process wire transfers. They also integrate custom elements, stay on track with notifications, and collaborate with teammates all from a single Jet admin panel.

Jet Admin was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.
